howToEdit: This file is the outline, in Google Doc BODY order (ignore the table of contents at the top of that doc). Reorder objects in events[] (and nested children[]) to rearrange the chart. Keep each event's uid; the outline id is rewritten when items move, but uid stays put so scriptures.json eventUid still points at the same event. Put scripture references on an event as strings; verse text is looked up from scriptures.json and is never stored here. time is the label drawn at the start of a 1st-order epoch. Leave children as [] when a heading has no nested events.
title: Chronological Outline of Scripture Prophecy

events.title: MOSAIC DISPENSATIONAL PATTERN & 490-YEAR PROPHECY CYCLES
events.summary: Moses institutes the divine sevenfold pattern of chastisement, scattering, and gathering of Israel, establishing the 490-year prophetic cycle.

children.title: Establishment of the Seven Dispensations of Scattering and Gathering
The 'Seven Times' Covenant Penalty
children.summary: Moses declares that Israel will be punished 'seven times' for disobedience, prefiguring seven historical cycles of captivity and restoration.

children.title: The 490-Year Sabbatical Precession Framework
children.summary: Integration of 70 sabbatical weeks (70 × 7 = 490 years) connecting the jubilee calendar with celestial cycles.

children.title: Typological Archetype of Egyptian Bondage
children.summary: Israel's 215/430-year captivity in Egypt set as the historical pattern for latter-day gentile sojourns.

children.title: The Sabbatical Jubilee and Intercalary Probation Cycles
The 49-Year Jubilee Proclamation
children.summary: The sounding of the trumpet of the jubilee on the Day of Atonement, freeing captives and returning land inheritances.

children.title: The 40-Year Probationary Offset
children.summary: The recurrent 40-year window between decree and ultimate destruction/deliverance throughout Israelite history.

events.title: THE DAVIDIC COVENANT & THE ROYAL MESSIANIC LINEAGE
events.summary: Establishment of the Davidic dynasty with the solemn prophetic decree that the eternal Messiah and King would emerge through the lineage of David.

children.title: The Dynastic Promise of an Everlasting Throne
Prophecy of the Eternal King
children.summary: Nathan foretells that David's throne and seed will be established forever before God.

children.title: The Rod from the Stem of Jesse
children.summary: Isaiah foretells the Branch emerging from the roots of Jesse with wisdom and power.

children.title: The Suffering and Exaltation of David's Seed
The Psalm of Crucifixion
children.summary: Prophetic detail of piercing hands and feet, casting lots for vesture, and intense thirst.

children.title: The Royal Melchizedek Priest-King
children.summary: The Lord sits at the right hand of God until enemies become His footstool.

events.title: DANIEL'S FOUR SUCCESSIVE WORLD EMPIRES & 70 WEEKS
events.summary: Daniel interprets the Great Metallic Image and Four Great Beasts, mapping world history from Babylon to Rome and the prophetic timeline to the Messiah.

children.title: The Succession of the Four Imperial World Beasts
Babylonian Lion with Eagle Wings
children.summary: The golden head and winged lion representing the Neo-Babylonian Empire (605-539 BC).

children.title: Medo-Persian Bear Raised on One Side
children.summary: The silver chest and bear with three ribs in its mouth representing Medo-Persia (539-331 BC).

children.title: Macedonian Four-Winged Leopard
children.summary: The bronze belly and four-headed leopard representing Alexander's empire and division into four kingdoms.

children.title: Roman Terrible Beast with Iron Teeth
children.summary: The iron legs and ten-horned beast representing imperial Rome's shattering dominion.

children.title: Gabriel's Seventy Weeks Prophecy to Rebuild Jerusalem and Temple
Decree to Restore and Rebuild Jerusalem
children.summary: From Artaxerxes' decree (457 BC) seven weeks and threescore and two weeks (483 years) until Messiah.

children.title: Messiah Cut Off but Not for Himself
children.summary: After 62 weeks the Anointed One is executed, leading to the sacking of the sanctuary.

events.title: FIRST COMING OF CHRIST: NATIVITY, MINISTRY, & MIRACLES
events.summary: The mortal advent of Jesus Christ fulfilling hundreds of detailed prophecies regarding His miraculous birth, forerunner, baptism, and ministry.

children.title: The Virgin Birth and Messianic Nativity in Bethlehem
Virgin Birth of Immanuel
children.summary: Fulfillment of Isaiah's sign: a virgin conceiving and bearing a Son called Immanuel.

children.title: Ruler Out of Bethlehem Ephrathah
children.summary: Birth in Bethlehem of Judea, fulfilling Micah's ancient geographical prophecy.

children.title: The Forerunner and Mortal Ministry of Christ
Mission of John the Baptist
children.summary: Voice crying in the wilderness preparing the way of the Lord; baptism of Jesus in Jordan.

children.title: Calling of the Twelve Apostles and Healing Ministry
children.summary: Ministry of healing, preaching the Gospel of the Kingdom, and opening blind eyes in Galilee.

events.title: ATONEMENT, CRUCIFIXION, & FIRSTFRUITS RESURRECTION
events.summary: The infinite Atonement and sacrificial death of Christ, His burial, and His victorious resurrection as the Firstfruits of them that slept.

children.title: The Suffering, Rejection, and Crucifixion of the Messiah
Wounded for Our Transgressions
children.summary: The Suffering Servant despised, smitten, bruised for our iniquities, and led as a lamb to slaughter.

children.title: Crucifixion Witnessed by Ancient Prophets
children.summary: Zenok and Neum foretell the lifted up Savior and His burial in a rock sepulchre.

children.title: Resurrection and Firstfruits of the Righteous Dead
Opening of the Graves in Jerusalem
children.summary: Righteous saints awake from the dust and appear to many in the holy city following Christ's resurrection.

children.title: Christ the Firstfruits
children.summary: Conquest of death ensuring universal resurrection and the pattern of the first resurrection.

events.title: MINISTRY TO OTHER SHEEP & THREE GENERATIONS OF PEACE
events.summary: Physical cataclysms across the Americas during the crucifixion, followed by Christ's personal post-resurrection ministry at the temple in Bountiful.

children.title: Three Days of Darkness and Devastating American Seismic Cataclysms
Vapor of Darkness and Storms
children.summary: Thunder, tempest, sinking and burning of wicked cities across the promised land.

children.title: Three Days of Thick Darkness
children.summary: Total absence of light; no fires or candles can be kindled for three full days.

children.title: Christ's Personal Appearance at Bountiful and Golden Age of Peace
Descent of the Resurrected Lord
children.summary: Christ descends out of heaven, shows the prints of the nails, and establishes His Church.

children.title: Three Generations of Righteous Peace
children.summary: Two centuries of consecration, no rich or poor, no contentions, before the 4th generation apostasy.

events.title: ROMAN DESTRUCTION OF JERUSALEM & THE FIRST TRIBULATION
events.summary: Titus and the Roman legions destroy Jerusalem and the Second Temple, fulfilling the first Abomination of Desolation and scattering Israel into all nations.

children.title: The Razing of the Second Temple and Sacking of Jerusalem
Not One Stone Left Upon Another
children.summary: Roman siege completely razes the temple sanctuary so no stone stands upon another.

children.title: First Fulfillment of Daniel's Abomination of Desolation
children.summary: Idolatrous imperial Roman standards planted in the holy precincts.

children.title: Flight to the Mountains and the Worldwide Jewish Diaspora
Christian Flight to Pella
children.summary: Disciples heed Christ's warning and flee into the mountains without returning for possessions.

children.title: Worldwide Dispersion Among the Gentiles
children.summary: Surviving remnants led away captive into all nations, severed from the mother olive tree.

events.title: RISE OF THE GREAT & ABOMINABLE SYSTEM & WILDERNESS EXILE
events.summary: Corrupted religious-political empires strip plain and precious truths from the scriptures; the true Church of the Lamb is driven into the wilderness.

children.title: The Whore Riding the Ten-Horned Imperial Beast
Persecution of the Saints of God
children.summary: Slaying of the apostles and suppression of pure doctrine under Roman authority.

children.title: Excising Plain and Precious Covenants
children.summary: Deliberate removal of fundamental gospel truths from the biblical record.

children.title: The 1,260-Year Wilderness Exile of the True Church
The Woman Flees to the Wilderness
children.summary: The spiritual authority and priesthood withdrawn for a symbolic 1,260 days/years.

children.title: Apostasy Across the Gentile Nations
children.summary: Loss of direct revelation and universal fracturing into competing creeds.

events.title: THE LONG DISPERSION & THE ERA OF TRIBULATION
events.summary: Centuries of spiritual darkness, persistent wars, rumors of wars, false Christs, and natural chastisements while Israel remains scattered.

children.title: Persistent Social, Doctrinal, and Political Evils
The Love of Many Waxes Cold
children.summary: Iniquity abounds, and mankind declares that the Lord delayeth His coming.

children.title: Proliferation of Deceivers and False Christs
children.summary: Emergence of worldly philosophies and false messiahs leading millions astray.

children.title: Voice of Nature and Global Pestilences Calling Men to Repent
Earthquakes, Tempests, and Plagues
children.summary: Divine warnings through lightnings, famines, and the voice of thunder.

children.title: Wars and Rumors of Wars
children.summary: Incessant empire clashes while the end is yet withheld.

events.title: REDISCOVERY OF THE PROMISED LAND & BIRTH OF A FREE NATION
events.summary: The Spirit of God leads explorers and pilgrims across the great waters to establish a land of liberty dedicated to the restoration of the covenant.

children.title: Voyages Across the Waters to the Choice Land
The Man Among the Gentiles
children.summary: Columbus and early voyagers wrought upon by the Spirit of the Lord to cross the ocean.

children.title: Deliverance from Gentile Captivity
children.summary: Pilgrims and settlers humbleness before God, preserved from European crowns.

children.title: Establishment of the Constitutional Land of Liberty
Divine Foundation of American Freedom
children.summary: Gentiles delivered by the power of God out of the hands of all other nations in 1776.

children.title: Preservation of Rights for Gospel Restoration
children.summary: The Constitution established by wise men raised up for that very purpose.

events.title: RESTORATION OF THE GOSPEL & OPENING OF THE FULNESS OF TIMES
events.summary: Heavenly visions to Joseph Smith, translation of the Book of Mormon, restoration of priesthood keys, and the gathering of Israel begins.

children.title: The Great and Marvelous Work Commences
First Vision and Angelic Ministrations
children.summary: Father and Son appear to Joseph Smith; Moroni delivers ancient Nephite records.

children.title: Translation of the Book of Mormon
children.summary: Ancient record translated by the gift and power of God to convince Jew and Gentile that Jesus is the Christ.
scriptures: Title Page of Book of Mormon

children.title: Restoration of Priesthood Keys and the Times of the Gentiles
Moses, Elias, and Elijah in Kirtland Temple
children.summary: Commitment of keys for gathering Israel, the dispensation of Abraham, and turning hearts.

children.title: Light Breaks Forth Among Those in Darkness
children.summary: The Times of the Gentiles dualistically 'comes in' with the fullness of the gospel restored. Times of the Gentiles began at Israel's destruction in 70 AD.

events.title: MODERN INGATHERING OF JUDAH & 20TH-CENTURY GLOBAL CONFLICTS
events.summary: World Wars I and II break imperial powers; Jewish remnants return to Palestine, establishing the State of Israel (1948) as the fig tree blossoms.

children.title: World Wars and the Gathering to Palestine
The Parable of the Fig Tree Fulfilled
children.summary: Tender branches shoot forth in 1948 as Israel is reborn after nineteen centuries of dispersion.

children.title: Gathering of Jewish Exiles from the Four Quarters
children.summary: Immigration waves return descendants of Judah to the mountains of their fathers.

children.title: Consolidation of the Modern First World Beast System
Global Governance Consolidation
children.summary: Post-WWII emergence of multilateral institutions exercising dominion across all nations.

children.title: The 70-Year Hegemonic Cycle
children.summary: Western and Soviet power blocks dominating global politics throughout the mid-20th century.

events.title: LATTER-DAY SCOURGES & REJECTION OF GOSPEL FULLNESS
events.summary: Desolating sicknesses and pandemic scourges cover the earth; society rejects covenant foundations, setting the stage for Gentile judgment.

children.title: Desolating Sickness and the Overflowing Scourge
Global Pandemic and Economic Commotion
children.summary: Fulfillment of D&C 45:31: an overflowing scourge and desolating sickness covering the land.

children.title: Men's Hearts Failing Them for Fear
children.summary: Widespread societal anxiety and institutional breakdown across the nations.

children.title: Rejection of the Light and Fulfilled Gentile Probation
Turning Hearts from God Through Precepts of Men
children.summary: Wickedness abounds as Gentile cultures fully reject gospel standards.

children.title: The Times of the Gentiles Reaching Fullness
children.summary: Probationary window begins closing, transitioning the gospel priority back to Israel.

events.title: THE 70TH HEBDOMAD & SECOND ABOMINATION OF DESOLATION (FULLNESS OF THE GENTILES)
events.summary: The final week of Daniel: Jerusalem is besieged, the daily sacrifice taken away, holy places trampled for 42 months, and Two Witnesses minister in sackcloth.

children.title: The Siege of Jerusalem and Fall of the City
Second Fulfillment of Daniel's Abomination
children.summary: Jerusalem besieged again with fierce tribulation upon the Jews.

children.title: Trampling of the Holy City for Forty-Two Months
children.summary: Half the city goes into exile while foreign armies occupy the temple courts for 3.5 years.

children.title: Ministry and Resurrection of the Two Witnesses
Prophesying in Sackcloth for 1,260 Days
children.summary: Two prophets seal the heavens, turn water to blood, and smite the earth with plagues.

children.title: Death and Public Resurrection of the Witnesses
children.summary: Slain in the streets of Jerusalem, lying unburied 3.5 days, then standing and ascending into heaven.

events.title: COALITION ATTACK OF GOG & MAGOG FROM SYRIA
events.summary: Northern and Middle Eastern powers form a strategic military alliance encircling the mountains of Israel in preparation for the end-times siege.

children.title: The Strategic League of Northern and Regional Powers
The Northern Chief Prince and Allies
children.summary: Gog of Magog (northern power) allied with Persia (Iran), Cush (Ethiopia), and Put (Libya).

children.title: Gomer and the House of Togarmah
children.summary: Central Asian and Anatolian forces joining the coalition against unfortified Israeli settlements.

children.title: Jerusalem Made a Cup of Trembling and Heavy Stone
Global Diplomatic Isolation of Israel
children.summary: All surrounding nations and international bodies aligning against Jerusalem.

children.title: Withholding of Western Allied Protection
children.summary: The great betrayal wherein traditional allies withhold effective defense during the crisis.

events.title: ARM OF THE LORD BEGINS TO FALL ON GENTILE NATIONS & MISSIONARIES CALLED HOME
events.summary: Judgment begins at the house of the Lord and strikes the Gentiles; missionaries are called home as economic totalitarianism and internal collapses spread.

children.title: Missionaries Called Home and Sealing of the Law
Elders Called Out of the Vineyard
children.summary: Ministry among the Gentiles terminates as elders shake dust from their feet.

children.title: Testimony Sealed by the Wrath of Nature
children.summary: Earthquakes, tempests, and waves heaving beyond their bounds witness against the wicked.

children.title: Rise of the Second Beast and American Fragmentation
Totalitarian Commerce and Mark Enforcement
children.summary: Second beast mandates allegiance to buy or sell, persecuting those who refuse.

children.title: The Constitution Hanging by a Thread
children.summary: National collapse of gentile governments while righteous elders uphold liberty in Zion.

events.title: WORLD WAR III (ARMAGEDDON) & OVERTHROW OF BABYLON/ BEAST SYSTEM?
events.summary: World armies gather into the valley of Megiddo against Jerusalem; divine wrath descends, incinerating the beast, false prophet, and Babylon the Great.

children.title: Gathering of Global Armies to the Valley of Decision
Spirits of Devils Muster Earth's Kings
children.summary: Armies numbering 200 million converge around the mountains of Israel for total conquest.

children.title: Final Distress and Siege of Jerusalem's Remnant
children.summary: Israel's defense shattered, pushed to the brink of utter extermination.

children.title: Fall and Burning of Babylon the Great
Destruction of the Great Whore by Fire
children.summary: The corrupt world system collapsed in one hour, burned with devouring fire.

children.title: Casting of the Beast and False Prophet into the Lake of Fire
children.summary: Military and religious impostors destroyed without hand by divine power.

events.title: PUBLIC ADVENT: CHRIST SYMBOLIC ENTRANCE THROUGH THE MOUNT OF OLIVES
events.summary: Christ symbolically enters Jerusalem from the east; His foot touches the Mount of Olives, cleaving it in twain; the Jewish remnant recognizes their crucified Redeemer.

children.title: The Cleaving of Mount Olivet and Valley of Refuge
The Mount Cleaves East and West
children.summary: Jews escape through Mount Olives, the mounts split (symbolically?) and Christ enters..

children.title: The Lord Utters His Voice from Zion and Jerusalem
children.summary: All ends of the earth hear His decree; mountains melt and continents quake.

children.title: Recognition of the Messiah by the Jewish Remnant
What Are These Wounds in Thine Hands?
children.summary: Jews examine His pierced hands and feet, discovering He was wounded in the house of friends.

children.title: Mourning and National Redemption of Israel
children.summary: Bitterness of tears as the remnant realizes Jesus of Nazareth is their true King.

events.title: OPENING OF THE SEVENTH SEAL & CELESTIAL TERRORS
events.summary: Immediately following the tribulation of Jerusalem: the sun is blackened, the moon bathed in blood, stars fall like figs, and kings hide in caves.

children.title: Cosmic Disturbances and Solar-Lunar Eclipses
Sun Darkened and Moon Bathed in Blood (Near-east eclipse March 2034)
children.summary: The sun hides its face in shame; the moon turns to deep blood before the great day.

children.title: Stars Falling as Ripe Figs, Wormwood/Apophis (April 2029/March 2036)
children.summary: Meteorite storms and falling celestial debris shaking the stability of earth.

children.title: Worldwide Earthquakes and Terror Among Earth's Elites
The Earth Reeling to and Fro (Major Solar flare begins earth expansion event ~40yrs)
children.summary: Seismic waves shake continents; islands and mountains move out of their places.

children.title: Mighty Men Fleeing to Rocks and Caves
children.summary: Captains, kings, and bondmen cry for the mountains to fall on them and hide them from the Lamb.

events.title: THE GREAT SIGN OF THE SON OF MAN & PRIVATE ADVENT IN CLOUDS
events.summary: The Great Sign of the Son of Man appears across the sky, visible to all humanity; Christ appears in glory to His watching saints afar off.

children.title: The Global Celestial Ensign of the Coming Lord
Great Sign in Heaven Seen Together
children.summary: A glorious astronomical manifestation appearing like morning light shining from east to west.

children.title: Mourning of the Unprepared Tribes
children.summary: Inhabitants of the earth lament as the undeniable presence of the King draws near.

children.title: Private Appearance in Glory to Watchers and Virgins
Appearance to Those Who Watch and Wait
children.summary: Christ reveals Himself in the clouds of heaven with holy angels to those who have oil in their lamps.

children.title: Cut Off Are Those Who Fell Asleep
children.summary: The foolish virgins and careless disciples caught unprepared when the Bridegroom arrives.

events.title: FIRST TRUMP & FIRSTFRUITS OF THE RESURRECTION
events.summary: The sounding of the first trump: righteous dead awake and rise from graves, and living faithful saints are quickened and caught up into the clouds.

children.title: The Resurrection of the Sleeping Saints
The Trump Sounds on Mount Sinai
children.summary: The angelic trumpet awakes those who died in the covenant to receive crowns of glory.

children.title: Emergence from Graves into the Cloud
children.summary: Righteous dead ascend in the midst of the pillar of heaven to be with Christ.

children.title: Quickening and Catching Up of the Living Faithful
Translation in the Twinkling of an Eye
children.summary: Living righteous saints changed without tasting the lingering sting of death.

children.title: Caught Up Together with the Saints
children.summary: Saints caught up to meet the Lord in the air before judgment falls on the nations.

events.title: DISPENSATION OF THE FULNESS OF TIMES & GATHERING TO ZION FOR SAFETY
events.summary: Heavenly silence for the space of half an hour; judgments stayed while the 144,000 are sealed and the righteous gather to Zion, the only nation at peace.

children.title: The Heavenly Silence and Sealing of the 144,000
Four Angels Holding the Four Winds
children.summary: Destructions restrained across the sea and earth until servants are sealed in their foreheads.

children.title: Ordination of the 144,000 High Priests
children.summary: High priests ordained from all tribes to minister the everlasting gospel and gather the elect.

children.title: Establishment and Refuge of the New Jerusalem (Zion)
Decree to Gather to One Place
children.summary: Saints called to purchase lands and build up Zion as a city of refuge and safety.

children.title: The Only Nation Not at War
children.summary: Every man refusing to take arms against his neighbor must flee to Zion for defense.

events.title: 'LITTLE SEASON' WICKEDNESS & FINAL CONFLICT OF GOG AND MAGOG
events.summary: At the close of the Millennium, Satan is loosed for a little season; Michael leads heaven's hosts against hell's armies; the devil is cast out forever.

children.title: Satan Loosed to Deceive the Nations Once More
Men Begin Again to Deny God
children.summary: Mortal probation produces a final contingent who reject the divine government.

children.title: Muster of the Final Rebellious Host
children.summary: Satan gathers his forces like the sand of the sea around the camp of the saints.

children.title: Michael's Final Triumph and the Great White Throne
Battle of the Great God
children.summary: Michael the Archangel leads heavenly legions; hell's armies cast into outer darkness forever.

children.title: General Resurrection and Final Judgment
children.summary: Rest of the dead awake; books are opened; every soul judged according to works.

events.title: CLEANSING BY FIRE & INAUGURATION OF TERRESTRIAL EARTH
events.summary: God's presence melts mountains and boils waters; wicked consumed by plagues and fire; continents re-unite; Satan bound for a thousand years of peace.

children.title: Global Cleansing of Wickedness by Melting Fire
Presence as a Melting Fire
children.summary: Corruptible elements melt with fervent heat; proud and wicked burn as stubble.

children.title: Flesh-Consuming Plague Smashing Oppressors
children.summary: Plague strikes enemy armies: eyes rot in sockets and tongues consume in mouths.

children.title: Transfiguration to Terrestrial Glory and Satan Bound
Satan Chained in the Bottomless Pit
children.summary: The adversary bound so he can have no place in the hearts of men for 1,000 years.

children.title: Universal Harmony: No Death or Sorrow
children.summary: Lion feeds with ox; infants live to the age of a tree and are changed in a twinkling.

events.title: NEW HEAVEN, NEW EARTH, & CELESTIAL GLORY
events.summary: The temporal earth passes away as by fire and is resurrected into a celestial sphere like a sea of glass; New Jerusalem descends from God out of heaven.

children.title: Resurrection and Sanctification of the Globe
The Earth Resurrected to Celestial Order
children.summary: Earth abides the celestial law and is crowned with glory to become a great Urim and Thummim.

children.title: The Sea of Glass and Fire
children.summary: Sanctified, immortal state where all things past, present, and future are manifest before God.

children.title: Descent of the Holy City: The Heavenly New Jerusalem
City Adorned as a Bride for Her Husband
children.summary: The New Jerusalem descends from God out of heaven to dwell eternally with redeemed humanity.

children.title: No More Death, Sorrow, or Pain
children.summary: God wipes away all tears; all things are made new, and the saints inherit all things.
